import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotient

/-!
# Geometric quotients over a base

The factorization of an invariant morphism through a geometric quotient
commutes with a common base map. Consequently, two geometric quotients over
the same base are uniquely isomorphic over that base.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y Z S : Scheme.{u}}
  {act : G →* Aut X} {q : X ⟶ Y} (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)
  (f : X ⟶ Z) (hf : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ f = f)
  (pX : X ⟶ S) (pY : Y ⟶ S) (pZ : Z ⟶ S)
  (hq_over : q ≫ pY = pX) (hf_over : f ≫ pZ = pX)

include hq_over hf_over in
/-- Descent through a geometric quotient preserves the map to the base. -/
theorem factor_comp_base : hq.factor f hf ≫ pZ = pY := by
  letI := hq.epi
  apply (cancel_epi q).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, comp_factor, hf_over, hq_over]

include hq hf hq_over hf_over in
/-- An invariant morphism over the base factors uniquely over the base. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_over :
    ∃! v : Y ⟶ Z, q ≫ v = f ∧ v ≫ pZ = pY := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv_unique⟩ := hq.existsUnique_factor f hf
  refine ⟨v, ⟨hv, ?_⟩, fun w hw => hv_unique w hw.1⟩
  letI := hq.epi
  apply (cancel_epi q).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, hv, hf_over, hq_over]

variable {f hf pX pY pZ hq_over hf_over}

/-- The canonical comparison of two geometric quotients respects the base. -/
theorem iso_hom_comp_base {q' : X ⟶ Z} (hq' : IsGeometricQuotient act q')
    (hq_over : q ≫ pY = pX) (hq'_over : q' ≫ pZ = pX) :
    (hq.iso hq').hom ≫ pZ = pY :=
  hq.factor_comp_base q' hq'.invariant pX pY pZ hq_over hq'_over

/-- The inverse canonical comparison also respects the base. -/
theorem iso_inv_comp_base {q' : X ⟶ Z} (hq' : IsGeometricQuotient act q')
    (hq_over : q ≫ pY = pX) (hq'_over : q' ≫ pZ = pX) :
    (hq.iso hq').inv ≫ pY = pZ :=
  hq'.factor_comp_base q hq.invariant pX pZ pY hq'_over hq_over

include hq in
/-- Two geometric quotients over a base admit a unique isomorphism commuting
with both the quotient projections and the structure maps. -/
theorem existsUnique_iso_over {q' : X ⟶ Z} (hq' : IsGeometricQuotient act q')
    (hq_over : q ≫ pY = pX) (hq'_over : q' ≫ pZ = pX) :
    ∃! e : Y ≅ Z, q ≫ e.hom = q' ∧ e.hom ≫ pZ = pY := by
  letI := hq.epi
  refine ⟨hq.iso hq',
    ⟨hq.comp_iso_hom hq', hq.iso_hom_comp_base hq' hq_over hq'_over⟩, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  apply Iso.ext
  exact (cancel_epi q).mp (he.1.trans (hq.comp_iso_hom hq').symm)

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient
